config.label: API key identifier from WebAdmin (Security -> API keys)
config.description: API key identifier from WebAdmin (Security -> API keys). Generate a Standard pair; a DynDNS pair authenticates against one endpoint only.

config.label: API secret paired with the key
config.description: API secret paired with the key. Used only to sign requests; it is never transmitted.

config.label: Market selection
config.description: Market selection. Defaults to https://rest.websupport.sk. Also live: rest.websupport.cz, rest.websupport.hu, rest.websupport.se.

config.label: Set to 1 to register the 13 write tools
config.description: Set to 1 to register the 13 write tools. Omit for a read-only deployment, where they never appear in tools/list at all.

config.label: Set to 1 to register the 7 destructive tools, each of which also requires confirm: true on every call
config.description: Set to 1 to register the 7 destructive tools, each of which also requires confirm: true on every call. Independent of WEBSUPPORT_ALLOW_WRITE.
